content: WebUI session visibility is controlled by multiple state files (`webui/sessions/*.json`, `_index.json`, `state.db`), not just the session files themselves. Deleting only the file layer will not remove old sessions from the WebUI list; the state database must be updated or the session must be properly handed off.
